dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Inventory refers to the production of 1 kg rye grains extensive, at farm respectively rye straw extensive, at farm , both with a moisture content of 15%. The multioutput-process rye extensive delivers the co-products rye grains extensive, at farm (5969kg yield/ha) and rye straw extensive, at farm (3968kg yield/ha). Economic allocation with allocation factor of 90.3% to grains (exceptions see report).; UUID: 48615040-7acc-3859-81ea-9536d0aa387f

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: The yield data have been collected for the years 1996-2003.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Integrated production with extensive plant protection (no fungicides, insecticides and growth regulators)

# Included processes
The inventory includes the processes of soil cultivation, sowing, weed control, fertilisation, pest and pathogen control, harvest and grain drying. Machine infrastructure and a shed for machine sheltering is included. Inputs of fertilisers, pesticides and seed as well as grain transports to the regional processing center (10km) are considered. The direct emissions on the field are also included.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, pilot network, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services, information provided by retailers and expert knowledge. The production data were verified and adjusted by a group of experts.
